properties.markdown:
## NexusDetalleCluster: detalle del cluster seleccionado
Mismas filas que [GeneralNexus](#dashboards:name=GeneralNexus), acotadas al cluster del selector. **Ojo:** el HTTP del gateway no refleja errores SOAP; el error real está en la fila 2. Servicio o rquid puntual: [NexusDetalleServicio](#dashboards:name=NexusDetalleServicio).

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/api/api_PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws$/
| fields @timestamp, resourcePath, responseLatency, status, httpMethod
| filter isPresent(httpMethod) AND isPresent(status)
| stats count(*) as cantidadReq

properties.query:

properties.title: PCT95 latencia (ms)

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/api/api_PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws$/
| fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log,responseLatency,status
|display  status >= 200 AND status < 300 as code200 ,status >=500 as code500 , status >=400 and status <500 as code400 
|filter isPresent(status)
|stats sum( code200) AS code2xx , sum(code500) as code5xx , sum (code400) as code4xx, COUNT(*) AS totalRQ  by datefloor (@timestamp , 1m) as fecha
| sort fecha desc
| limit 10000
properties.title: STATUS CODE API (HTTP gateway)

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/api/api_PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws$/
| fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log,responseLatency,status
|filter isPresent(responseLatency)
|stats pct (responseLatency,95) AS PCT95 , avg (responseLatency) as promedio  by datefloor (@timestamp , 1m) as fecha
| sort fecha desc
| limit 10000
properties.title: LATENCIA API

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/api/api_PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws$/
| fields @log, resourcePath, responseLatency, status, httpMethod
| filter isPresent(httpMethod) AND isPresent(status)
| stats count(*) as cantidadReq,
    sum(status < 300) as status2xx,
    sum(status >= 400 and status < 500) as status4xx,
    sum(status >= 500) as status5xx,
    (sum(status >= 400) * 100 / count(*)) as pctErrorHttp,
    avg(responseLatency) as LatenciaPromedio,
    pct(responseLatency, 95) as LatenciaPct95
  by resourcePath, httpMethod
| sort status5xx desc, status4xx desc, cantidadReq desc
| limit 10000
properties.title: APIs Overview

properties.markdown: ### 2. Adaptadores del cluster: error real contra el backend

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-(stratus|iseries|postilion)-adapter$/
| fields @message
| filter @message like /GenericExceptionMapper/ and @message like /HttpCode::/
| stats count(*) as errores
properties.title: Errores adaptador

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/api/api_PREFIX_VAR", "/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter (@log like /ws$/ and isPresent(status)) or (@log like /ws-(stratus|iseries|postilion)-adapter$/ and @message like /GenericExceptionMapper/ and @message like /HttpCode::/)
| fields strcontains(@log, "/aws/api/") as esGateway, strcontains(@message, "GenericExceptionMapper") as esError
| stats (sum(esError) * 100 / sum(esGateway)) as value
properties.title: % error real (aprox.)

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-(stratus|iseries|postilion)-adapter$/
| fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /GenericExceptionMapper/ and @message like /HttpCode::/
| stats count(*) as errores by datefloor(@timestamp, 1m) as fecha
| sort fecha desc
| limit 10000
properties.title: ERRORES ADAPTADOR EN EL TIEMPO

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-(stratus|iseries|postilion)-adapter$/
| fields @message
| filter @message like /GenericExceptionMapper/ and @message like /HttpCode::/
| parse @message /Exception:\s*(?<errorMsg>\d+\s*::.+?)\s*::HEAD::/
| parse errorMsg /^(?<codigo>\d+)/
| parse @message /X-Referer=[^-,]+-[^-,]+-[^-,]+-(?<service>[^-,\]]+)/
| parse @message /X-Name=(?<channel>[^,\]]+)/
| stats count(*) as total by codigo, errorMsg, service, channel
| sort total desc
| limit 10000
properties.title: ERRORES ADAPTADOR POR MENSAJE / SERVICIO / CANAL

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-(stratus|iseries|postilion)-adapter$/
| fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log
|filter @message like "RSIN"
|parse @message "RSIN *:*,3=*" as adaptador ,temp1,  rsinadpstratus
|parse @message "RSIN *:*, 1=*" as  adaptador1 , temp , rsinloaniseris
|display coalesce (rsinadpstratus,rsinloaniseris) as TiempoAdp
|stats pct(TiempoAdp , 95) as pct95 , avg (TiempoAdp) as promedio  by datefloor (@timestamp,1m) 

| limit 10000
properties.title: LATENCIA  ADAPTADOR

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-(stratus|iseries|postilion)-adapter$/
| fields @log
|parse @log /\/aws\/ecs\/srv\/(?<Adaptador>\S+)$/
| stats count(*) as eventos by Adaptador
| sort eventos desc
| limit 10000
properties.title: ADAPTADORES EN USO

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-(stratus|iseries|postilion)-adapter$/
| fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log
|filter @message like "RSIN"
|parse @message "RSIN *:*,3=*" as adaptador ,temp1,  rsinadpstratus
|parse @message "RSIN *:*, 1=*" as  adaptador1 , temp , rsinloaniseris
|parse @log /\/aws\/ecs\/srv\/(?<Adaptador>\S+)$/
|display coalesce (rsinadpstratus,rsinloaniseris) as TiempoAdp, Adaptador

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-mngr$/
| fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like "[ERROR !]"
| stats COUNT(*) AS total_errors  by datefloor (@timestamp , 1m) AS fecha
| limit 10000
properties.title: ERROR LOGS

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-mngr$/
| fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like "[ERROR !]"
| parse @message "* ERROR *" as date, full_details
| parse full_details "[*][*]*" as uuid_opcinal, canal_raw, msg_raw
| fields if(isPresent(canal_raw), canal_raw, "--") as canal,
         if(isPresent(msg_raw), msg_raw, full_details) as message
| stats COUNT(*) AS total_errors BY canal, message
| sort total_errors desc
| limit 10000
properties.title: RESUMEN ERRORES POR CANAL

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-mngr$/
| fields @message
| filter @message like 'ERROR'
| parse @message /<nombreOperacion>(?<nombreOperacion>[^<]+)<\/nombreOperacion>/
| parse @message /<msgRespuesta>(?<msgRespuesta>[^<]+)<\/msgRespuesta>/
| filter isPresent(msgRespuesta)
| stats count(*) as CantidadErrores by nombreOperacion, msgRespuesta
| sort CantidadErrores desc
| limit 10000
properties.title: ERRORES POR OPERACIÓN / RESPUESTA

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-mngr$/
| fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log
|filter @message LIKE "::AUDIT::REQ::" or @message like "::AUDIT::RESP::"
|parse @message "::HTTPCODE::*" as CodesHTTP
|parse @message "::[X-RqUid=*,X-Name=PN-" as RqUidReq
|parse @message "X-Referer=*,X-RqUid=*,X" as ApiCliente , RqUidResp
|#filter CodesHTTP > 399
|parse @message /BODY::(?<body>\{.*\})/ 
|display jsonParse(body) as body1
|filter ispresent(CodesHTTP)  and ispresent (body1.error.system)
|display  CodesHTTP  , body1.error.code  , body1.error.system  , body1.error.message  , body1.from.productType  , coalesce(RqUidResp,RqUidReq) as RqUid , ApiCliente , substr(@log,13) as logroup
|stats count (*) as CantReq  by  body1.error.message , body1.error.system ,  logroup
| sort CantReq desc , logroup asc
| limit 1000
properties.title: SUMATORIA EVENTOS APIS

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-mngr$/
| fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log
|filter @message like "::AUDIT::REQ::" or @message like "::AUDIT::RESP::"
|parse @message "::HTTPCODE::*" as CodesHTTP
|parse @message "::[X-RqUid=*,X-Name=PN-" as RqUidReq
|parse @message "X-Referer=*,X-RqUid=*,X" as ApiCliente , RquidResp
|filter CodesHTTP > 399
|parse @message /BODY::(?<body>\{.*\})/ 
|display jsonParse(body) as body1
|display CodesHTTP , body1.error.code , body1.error.system , body1.error.message , body1.from.productType , coalesce(RquidResp,RqUidReq) as RqUid , ApiCliente , substr(@log,13) as logroup
|stats count (*) as CantReq  by RqUid , body1.error.message , body1.error.system , datefloor (@timestamp , 5m ) as fecha , logroup
| sort fecha desc
| limit 200
properties.title: RQUIDS CON ERROR 4XX/5XX

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-mngr$/
| fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log
|filter @message LIKE "RSOUT" 
|PARSE @message "dt.trace_id=*" AS traceid
|PARSE @message "1=*" as statusCode
| parse @message /\(executor-thread-\d+\) \[(?<var1>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<canal>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<var3>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<var4>[^\]]+)\]/
| parse @message /RSOUT Servicio\s*(?<rsin_servicio>\S+)/
|display rsin_servicio,canal,statusCode
|stats count (*) as cantidadReq by rsin_servicio,canal,statusCode,@log
| sort cantidadReq desc
| limit 10000
properties.title: Consumos Canal-Api (RSOUT)

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-mngr$/
| fields @timestamp, @message
| parse @message /\[(?<rquid>[a-f0-9\-]+)\].*\[(?<servicio>\/[^\]]+)\].*\[(?<Paso>[^\[\]]+)\]\[(?<Tiempo>[^\[\]]+)\]$/
| filter ispresent(rquid) and ispresent(Paso) and ispresent(Tiempo) and Tiempo != '-' and Tiempo != 'AuditLog'
| stats count(*) as ejecuciones, avg(Tiempo) as promedio, pct(Tiempo, 95) as pct95 by Paso
| sort pct95 desc
| limit 100
properties.title: LATENCIA POR PASO ESB
